phase.method: Same known-preamble method as capture 01: 129-tap lowpass and 4:1 decimation; normal squared-IQ CFO; search 40 symbol timings among CRC-valid alignments, minimize normalized within-state complex variance on central 8/40 samples of 248 preamble symbols; omit four symbols at each end. One additional common linear phase slope, independent state centers; no per-symbol rotation.

power_state: Only 5 V was switched off between captures; 3.3 V remained on. Both rails were reported ON before capture 02, same RF chain. COMMS boot ID remained unchanged; not a complete power cycle.
logging_failure: Logger 02 wrote readiness then exited due to duplicate utc keyword in event construction. Its finally block restored debug output. Pre-transmit liveness check caught the failure, no RF command was sent. Logger 03 fixed the exception, verified process survival after readiness and covered heartbeat 19 and its post-result interval. Original failed logger files retained.
analysis_validation: Reanalysis reproduces first published timing, variance metric, coarse separation, common frequency refinement and final separation to floating-point precision. Earlier local analysis draft used variance divided by center energy instead of total point energy; corrected draft retained separately. This monotonic metric change did not alter selected timing or either final separation.
limitations: Two completed RF attempts across two captures, copies on channel 1 count once. Normal decoder only returns CRC-valid packets; no BER or final PER statistics. Full independent TX bytes not retained. Relative CFO and digital power are not calibrated absolute measurements. Timing sensitivity is not a confidence interval. State spreads are within one preamble.
